statements.statement: A member relayed a state senator's advice to plan conservatively for up to a 20 to 25 percent cut in local aid.
A member said all free cash should be thought of as going to stabilization.

warnings.prediction: State revenues are falling, the rainy day fund will be depleted, and the town must assume the worst on aid.
